instruction:
Write a story about: Tim accidentally breaks a window while playing with his heavy ball, but apologizes and is forgiven by his friend.
With: happy ending
response:
While playing, Tim accidentally threw the ball too hard. It went to the other side of his friend's house and broke a window. Tim was very scared and sad. He knew he had made a mistake.
Tim went to his friend's house and said sorry for breaking the window. His friend was kind and said, "I forgive you, Tim. We all make mistakes sometimes." Tim felt happy that his friend forgave him, and they both played together with the heavy ball on the safe side of the house.
Summary: Tim accidentally breaks a window while playing with his heavy ball, but apologizes and is forgiven by his friend.

instruction:
Write a story about: Nathan feeds his friends a dirty pastel he found in the park, making them sick and requiring a trip to the hospital.
With: sad ending
response:
Once there was a boy named Nathan. He was only 3 years old. One day he was playing in the park with his friends. He saw a pastel lying on the ground and was curious so he decided to pick it up. Nathan was so excited. He decided to feed it to his friends. 
Nathan's friends opened up the pastel and noticed it was dirty. They all knew this was not a good idea. "Let us not feed this pastel", one of Nathan's friends said. Nathan didn't agree and started to feed it to his friends. 
Suddenly, all of them started to feel sick. Nathan was scared and didn't know what to do. He wanted to help his friends. Unfortunately, it was too late. All of his friends had to go to the hospital because of the dirty pastel. Luckily they all recovered, but Nathan had learned a lesson. Never feed something dirty.

instruction:
Write a story about: A little boy befriends a big dragon with icy blue eyes, but the dragon gets sick and dies, leaving the boy sad and missing his friend.
With: sad ending
response:
One day, the dragon met a little boy. The little boy was scared, but the dragon was nice. They played together and became friends. The dragon would blink and make the little boy laugh. 
But one day, the dragon got sick. The little boy tried to help, but he could not. The dragon blinked one last time and went to sleep. The little boy was sad and missed his friend, the icy-eyed dragon.

instruction:
Write a story about: A little duck plays in a pond and tries to catch her shadow, but gets scared by a harmless tree shadow and drowns in the pond. Her friends miss her and avoid the scary shadow.
With: sad ending
response:
Suddenly, a big, scary shadow appeared behind her. It was a harmless tree, but the little duck didn't know that. She got scared and started to run away, but she tripped on a rock and fell into the water. She tried to swim back to the shore, but she was too tired. 
Sadly, the little duck drowned in the pond. Her friends tried to save her, but it was too late. They were all very sad and missed their friend. From that day on, they never played near the big, scary shadow again.

instruction:
Write a story about: Sarah and Joe learn to share a seat at the park and promise to always be fair to each other.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time, there were two children, Sarah and Joe. They were at the park and saw a seat. Joe rushed to the seat, sat on it and started to complain. He said, “It’s too hot, I don’t like it here!" 
But Sarah said, “That’s not nice, Joe. We should share the seat.” Joe shouted, “No! It’s my seat, I want to stay here!”
Sarah was getting upset and said, “It’s not fair! Just because you’re bigger than me, you don’t get to be ignorant and have all the fun.”
Joe thought about it for a moment and then said, “Okay, let’s share the seat. I’m sorry I was complaining.”
So Sarah and Joe shared the seat and had lots of fun. And they promised to always be fair to each other. The end.

instruction:
Write a story about: A little girl overcomes her fear of falling from the monkey bars and successfully makes it down, feeling proud and happy with herself.
With: happy ending
response:
The little girl was embarrassed. She was at the top of the monkey bars and she had to go down. She was scared and didn't want to fall.
She closed her eyes and minded her own thoughts. She took a deep breath, and then stepped down slowly.
She made it to the bottom of the monkey bars! She smiled, feeling proud of herself.
"Good job!" said her mom. Her mom was proud of her and gave her a big hug.
The little girl felt happy and relieved that she had minded her own thoughts and conquered the monkey bars.

instruction:
Write a story about: Tom makes a special gift for his Mom by cutting out two hearts from a piece of pretty paper, and his Mom is very happy and grateful.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tom. Tom was a thoughtful boy. He enjoyed doing nice things for his family and friends. 
One day, Tom wanted to make his Mom something special. He found a piece of pretty paper and drew a big heart on it. He took a pair of scissors and cut two hearts out of the paper.
Tom was excited to give his Mom the special gift he made. He gave the hearts to his Mom and she was so happy. She hugged Tom tight and thanked him for being so thoughtful.
Tom left the house feeling proud. He had made his Mom a very special present, and that made him happy.
Summary: Tom makes a special gift for his Mom by cutting out two hearts from a piece of pretty paper, and his Mom is very happy and grateful.

instruction:
Write a story about: Vicky is a jazz dancer who is followed by a stranger late at night while practicing her moves, causing her to quit her job and put her dream on hold.
With: sad ending
response:
Vicky was so enthusiastic to start her new job. She was working as a jazz dancer. Late at night, she left to practice her jazz moves. Then suddenly, she saw a stranger following her. He was not being nice.
Vicky was scared and shouted, “Why are you following me? I don’t know you!” 
But the stranger wouldn't leave her. He kept coming closer. Telling her to do what he wanted.
Vicky ran home as fast as she could, but he followed her all the way. She had to get help.
Vicky was so scared she started to cry.  Suddenly, she heard her neighbor shouting, "Where is he? Show me!"
But the stranger had already gone. Vicky was too frightened to dance jazz anymore.  She had to quit her job and put her dream of dancing jazz on hold.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily learns to play the violin and becomes good enough to teach her friend.
With: happy ending
response:
Lily's mommy took her to a music store to buy a violin. The violin was very beautiful and strong. Lily's mommy said, "The violin includes four strings and a bow. You have to be very gentle when you play it."
Lily practiced playing the violin every day. She played so well that her mommy and daddy were very proud of her. One day, Lily's friend came over and asked her what she was doing. Lily said, "I am playing the violin! It is so much fun!" Her friend said, "Wow, you are so good! Can you teach me?" And Lily said, "Yes, I can teach you how to play the violin too!"

instruction:
Write a story about: Tim likes to play pretend and pretended to be a king, but his little sister did not want to play along. His mom taught him to be kind to others and they played a new game together.
With: happy ending
response:
One day, Tim decided to pretend he was a king. He put on his dad's clothes and told his little sister, Lily, to do what he said. Lily did not like this game. She wanted to play with her toys. Tim got mad and yelled at Lily.
Mom saw Tim yelling and told him it was not nice to treat others that way. Tim felt sad and said sorry to Lily. They decided to play a new game together. They pretended to be superheroes and saved their toys from danger. Tim learned that it is better to play together and be kind to others.

instruction:
Write a story about: A little girl sees a helicopter fly in the sky and enjoys it, but when it crashes, she becomes scared and sad and never wants to see a helicopter again.
With: sad ending
response:
But then, something bad happened. The helicopter started to fold! The girl saw it fall from the sky and crash on the ground. She felt sad and scared. 
The girl ran to tell her mommy what happened. Her mommy hugged her and said it was okay. They went to see if they could help the people in the helicopter. But when they got there, they saw that no one could be saved. The helicopter was too broken. The girl felt even more sad. 
From that day on, the girl never wanted to see a helicopter again. She knew they could be dangerous. She hoped no one else would have to see one fold and crash like she did.

instruction:
Write a story about: A little purple cow eats too much hay from a field and gets stuck, eventually passing away without anyone knowing.
With: sad ending
response:
The little purple cow was so happy to eat all the hay. But then, she ate too much and got a tummy ache. She tried to push herself up, but she was too heavy. She was stuck in the field all alone, and no one could hear her moo for help. 
Days went by and the little purple cow grew weaker and weaker. She missed her friends and family, but she couldn't move. Finally, she closed her eyes and went to sleep forever. The other cows never knew what happened to her, and they kept eating their hay in the field next door.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lucy the cat and Max the dog play with a big sheet, but it gets caught on a tree and rips, teaching them to be more careful with things they find.
With: sad ending
response:
Lucy saw her friend, a dog named Max. She said, "Max, come play with me! I have a big sheet and we can run on it together!" Max came over and started to run on the sheet with Lucy. They laughed and had a great time.
But then, the sheet got caught on a tree. Lucy and Max tried to pull it free, but the sheet ripped. The pretty sheet was now broken. Lucy and Max were sad. They learned that they should be more careful when playing with things they find.
Summary: Lucy the cat and Max the dog play with a big sheet, but it gets caught on a tree and rips, teaching them to be more careful with things they find.

instruction:
Write a story about: Erik disobeys his mother by playing in the mud and is punished by being made to stay under his bed for a long time. He realizes the importance of obeying his parents and apologizes to them when he is let out.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time there was a boy named Erik. He was a good boy, but one day he did something bad. His mother had told him not to play in the mud, but Erik didn't listen.
So his mother had to punish him. She said, Erik, you have to stay downstairs under your bed for a long time. He was sad and scared, but he knew he had to obey his mother or else he would get in more trouble.
Erik stayed under his bed for what felt like forever. He heard his mom yelling and he heard his dad laughing. Then he heard them both say, "We love you, Erik".
When Erik was let out, he knew that he had been given a long punishment for disobeying his parents. He hugged them both and said he was sorry. They smiled and said it was ok. Erik knew from then on to always do what his parents said.

instruction:
Write a story about: A little girl named Lily makes friends with a harmless bunny she meets in a field and learns to be kind to harmless animals.
With: happy ending
response:
"Hello, little bunny!" Lily said.
"Hi there!" replied the bunny.
Lily stepped closer to the bunny and asked, "Can I pet you?"
"Sure," said the bunny. "I won't harm you."
Lily gently petted the bunny and they became friends. They played together in the field every day. And from that day on, Lily always remembered to be kind to harmless animals like her bunny friend.

instruction:
Write a story about: A pirate named Tom loses his treasure and prays for help. A big fish leads him to the treasure on a small island and they become best friends.
With: happy ending
response:
"Please help me find my treasure," Tom prayed. Just then, a big fish jumped out of the water. The fish said, "I know where your treasure is! Follow me!"
Tom followed the big fish through the cold water. They swam until they found a small island. On the island, there was a big X on the ground. "Dig here!" said the big fish.
Tom dug and dug until he found a big box. Inside the box was his lost treasure! Tom was so happy. He thanked the big fish and prayed again, "Thank you for helping me find my treasure!"
From that day on, Tom and the big fish were best friends. They played in the cold water and had lots of fun together.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy plays catch with his friend Johnny, who has to leave early. Timmy practices catching the ball by himself and eventually succeeds with determination and encouragement from Johnny.
With: happy ending
response:
They played catch for a while, but then Johnny said, "I can't play anymore. I have to go home." Timmy was sad that Johnny had to leave, but he didn't want to stop playing. So, he decided to practice catching the ball by himself.
Timmy threw the ball up in the air, but it was a little rough and he missed it. He tried again and again, but he just couldn't catch it. Timmy was getting frustrated and was about to give up. But then he remembered what Johnny had told him earlier in the week. Johnny said, "If you keep practicing, you'll get better and better every day!" So, Timmy kept trying and trying until he finally caught the ball. He was so happy and proud of himself!

instruction:
Write a story about: The animals in a forest complain about low water levels in a creek until it runs dry, forcing them to search for water elsewhere.
With: sad ending
response:
Once upon a time, there was a small creek that ran through a big forest. The animals of the forest were very happy because the creek was always available for them to get fresh water.
One day, the animals began to complain because the water was getting low in the creek. They said the creek needed to be filled up so that they could get the fresh water they loved.
The animals complained and complained until finally, one day, the creek completely ran dry. Everyone was sad because the water was not available anymore.
The animals had to search far and wide to find enough fresh water to drink.
The end.
Summary: The animals in a forest complain about low water levels in a creek until it runs dry, forcing them to search for water elsewhere.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy, a little mouse, finds a bell that he uses to scare away a scary cat and keep himself safe.
With: happy ending
response:
The next day, Timmy decided to be brave and explore again. He found a big room with a shiny object. He was so happy to find it! But then he heard the roar again. This time, he realized it was coming from a big, scary cat. Timmy was scared and didn't know what to do.
Suddenly, he remembered the shiny object he found. It was a bell! Timmy quickly ran back to the bell and rang it as loud as he could. The loud noise scared the cat away and Timmy was safe. From that day on, Timmy was very happy and never forgot how the bell saved him from the roaring cat.

instruction:
Write a story about: A hungry lion finds a jar of cookies in the jungle and roars with joy, causing the jar to shake and the cookies to spill out, leaving him with enough to eat for days.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time, there was a big lion who was very hungry. He had been walking through the jungle all day, looking for something to eat.
Suddenly, he came across a big jar of cookies. They were big and smelled so sweet! The lion was very excited. He reached in and grabbed a cookie, and then took a big bite. It was delicious!
The lion liked it so much that he roared with joy. He roared so loudly, that it echoed through the whole jungle. It was so loud that it made all of the animals in the jungle jump.
But then something very strange happened. The lion's roar was so tight that the jar started to shake. And within a few seconds, the lid came off and all the cookies poured out.
The lion was so happy! He laughed and ran around the jungle, still roaring with joy. He had enough cookies to eat for days! From then on, the lion was never hungry again.

instruction:
Write a story about: Sam goes to the park, pets a dog, draws a picture of it, and sends it to his mom.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time there was a hot day. Sam liked to go outside and play. He ran over to the park and saw a gentle dog that was wagging his tail. Sam bent down and petted the dog.
The dog liked when Sam pet him so he licked Sam's face. It felt nice and gentle. Sam laughed and stood up.
Sam wanted to send his mom a picture of the dog. He ran home and grabbed a piece of paper and a pen. He carefully drew a picture of the dog on the paper. Then he folded the paper up and put it in an envelope. He wrote his mom's address on the envelope and went to the post office to mail it.
He handed the envelope to the mailman and the mailman said he would get it to Sam's mom. Sam smiled and waved goodbye.
The end!

instruction:
Write a story about: A 3-year-old boy named John was scared during a flood, but his mother comforted him with hugs and gentle words, reassuring him that he was safe and everything would be alright.
With: happy ending
response:
John was scared when the flood came. He was only 3 and he didn't know what to do. He sat in a corner and cried loudly.
His mother heard him and ran to him. She hugged him tightly and spoke softly. She told him it would be alright and that he was safe.
John was still scared, but he felt a little better. His mother stroked his head and gave him a big hug. She told him the flood would soon be gone and the sun would shine again soon.
John nodded and smiled. His mother smiled back. She kissed his forehead and promised him things would be fair soon.
John felt much better after that. He was comforted by his mother's gentle words and hugs. He knew he would be ok and everything would be alright in the end.

instruction:
Write a story about: Tim loses his beloved toy bear at the park and cannot find it again, teaching him the importance of remembering to take his things with him when he leaves a place.
With: sad ending
response:
At the park, Tim played with his toy bear. He held it by the arm and swung it around. Then, he saw some unknown kids playing with a ball. Tim wanted to play with them too. He put his toy bear down and went to join the other kids.
After playing for a while, Tim's mom said it was time to leave the park. Tim was tired and forgot about his toy bear. He left the park with his mom without his toy bear.
When they got home, Tim looked for his toy bear, but it was not there. He started to cry. Tim's mom knew that they had left the toy bear at the park. They went back to find it, but it was gone. Someone had taken it.
Tim was very sad. He had lost his toy bear and could not find it again. He learned that he should always remember to take his things with him when he leaves a place.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily loses her family's passport while on a trip and they have to go back home, teaching her to keep important things close to her.
With: sad ending
response:
While they were walking, Lily got tired and sat down on a bench. She put the passport down next to her and fell asleep. When she woke up, she looked for the passport, but it was gone. She started to cry and told her mommy that she lost the passport. They couldn't go on the trip without it.
Lily's family had to go back home and they were very sad. Lily never saw her brown teddy bear again and she missed it very much. She learned to always keep important things close to her so she would never lose them again.

instruction:
Write a story about: Two friends, Tim and Sam, fight over a shiny ring and end up losing it in a deep hole, learning that fighting over things can lead to bad endings.
With: sad ending
response:
Sam was sad and angry. He wanted the ring, so he thought of a plan. When Tim was not looking, Sam took the ring from Tim's finger. Tim saw Sam take the ring and they started to fight. They both wanted the ring, but they did not want to share.
As they fought, the ring fell into a deep hole. Tim and Sam looked at the hole and knew they could not get the ring back. The result was that they both lost the ring. Tim and Sam were very sad and their friendship was hurt. They learned that fighting over things can lead to bad endings.
Summary: Two friends, Tim and Sam, fight over a shiny ring and end up losing it in a deep hole, learning that fighting over things can lead to bad endings.

instruction:
Write a story about: Mittens, a little cat, loved to play hide and seek with a rubber ball. She hid it in the garden but forgot where she had buried it. Later, she swallowed the ball and passed away.
With: sad ending
response:
Mittens wanted to hide the rubber ball from her owner, so she took it to the garden and buried it in the dirt. But when she went back to find it, she couldn't remember where she had hidden it. She searched and searched, but the ball was nowhere to be found. 
Mittens was very sad and went back inside the house. Later that day, she started to feel sick. Her owner took her to the vet and they found out that she had swallowed the rubber ball. The ball got stuck in her throat and she couldn't breathe. Sadly, Mittens passed away and her owner was very sad.

instruction:
Write a story about: A princess is given a razor to play with by her mother, but she cuts herself and dies despite being taken to the hospital. Her mother regrets giving her the razor.
With: sad ending
response:
But the princess was not careful. She accidentally cut herself with the razor. It hurt a lot and she cried. Her mommy took her to the hospital, but it was too late. The princess had lost too much blood and could not be saved. 
The mommy was very sad and wished she had never given the razor to the princess. She promised herself to never make that mistake again. The end.
Summary: A princess is given a razor to play with by her mother, but she cuts herself and dies despite being taken to the hospital. Her mother regrets giving her the razor.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily enjoys writing and drawing, and creates a simple picture with her favorite colors. Her parents compliment her on her work, and Lily feels happy and proud.
With: happy ending
response:
Lily chose her favorite colors: red, blue, and yellow. She started to write and draw on the paper. She made a big sun, a blue sky, and a red house. It was easy and fun for Lily. She was very happy with her picture.
When Lily finished her picture, she showed it to her mom and dad. They smiled and said, "Good job, Lily! Your picture is very nice!" Lily felt proud and happy. She knew that writing and drawing was fun and easy.

instruction:
Write a story about: A boy named Timmy cuts his finger with a knife and has to go to the hospital where his finger has to be cut off, teaching him the lesson to never play with sharp things.
With: sad ending
response:
But Timmy didn't know how to use the knife safely. He accidentally cut his finger and it hurt a lot. His mommy took him to the doctor, but the cut was too deep. Timmy had to go to the hospital.
At the hospital, the doctors tried to fix Timmy's finger, but it was too late. Timmy's finger had to be cut off. Timmy was very sad and cried a lot. He learned a very important lesson that day: never play with sharp things.

instruction:
Write a story about: A little girl named Lily meets a happy spirit in the woods and they play together, but when it gets dark, the spirit becomes mean and doesn't let Lily leave. Lily gets lost in the woods with the mean spirit and is never found again.
With: sad ending
response:
"Hello, Lily!" said the happy spirit. "Do you want to play with me?"
Lily was very scared, but she wanted to be brave. So, she said, "Yes, I will play with you, happy spirit."
They played together for a long time. But then, it started to get dark. Lily knew she had to go home, but the happy spirit didn't want her to leave. The spirit got angry and didn't want to be friends anymore.
Lily tried to run away, but the spirit followed her. The spirit was not happy anymore. It was now a mean spirit. Lily was very sad and scared. She couldn't find her way home, and the mean spirit stayed with her. And so, Lily stayed lost in the woods, never to be found again.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily's little brother accidentally broke her bookcase, which was replaced with a new one. However, while waiting for the new bookcase, her brother started a fire that burned down their house and all of Lily's books.
With: sad ending
response:
Lily was sad because her books were all over the floor. She tried to fix the bookcase, but it was too broken. So, her dad said he would replace it with a new one. 
But while they were waiting for the new bookcase to arrive, Lily's little brother kept playing in her room. He accidentally knocked over a lamp and started a fire. Everyone got out safely, but the fire burned down the whole house, including Lily's beloved books. 
Lily was very sad and cried for a long time. She realized that sometimes accidents happen, but it's important to be careful and not play with fire.

instruction:
Write a story about: Sue helps a struggling flower by holding her big, red umbrella over it, and they become good friends.
With: happy ending
response:
One day, Sue went outside to play. The sun was shining, and the birds were singing. As she played, she saw a small flower on the ground. It was trying to rise up, but the hot sun was making it hard for the flower.
Sue wanted to help the flower. She opened her big, red umbrella and held it over the flower. The flower said, "Thank you, Sue! You are so kind!" Sue smiled and said, "You're welcome, little flower! I'm happy to help!"
The flower began to rise, and soon it was standing tall and strong. Sue and the flower became good friends. They played together every day, and Sue always brought her reliable umbrella to keep the flower safe and happy.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy loved to watch cartoons all day long until his mom explained to him that watching too much screen is not good for his health. He learned an important lesson and now finishes watching after a little while and goes outside to play with his friends.
With: happy ending
response:
One day, Timmy's mom got angry and turned off the screen. Timmy was sad and didn't understand why his mom did that. His mom explained to him that watching too much screen is not good for his health and he needs to finish watching after a little while.
Timmy learned an important lesson that day. He realized that he needs to be kind to his body and not watch too much screen. Now, he finishes watching after a little while and goes outside to play with his friends.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy and his mommy ride the subway for the first time, but it gets stuck and they are late for their appointment.
With: sad ending
response:
As they rode the subway, Timmy was alert and looked out the window to see all the buildings and people. Suddenly, the subway made a loud noise and stopped. Timmy's mommy tried to calm him down, but he was scared. 
A man on the subway said, "Don't worry, we'll be moving soon." But the subway didn't move, and it got very hot. Timmy started to cry, and his mommy tried to comfort him. They were stuck in the subway for a long time. When they finally got out, they were very late for their appointment. Timmy was sad that they missed it.

instruction:
Write a story about: A little white bunny loves to play in the grass, but after getting wet in the rain and being chased by a dog, it is injured and can no longer play.
With: sad ending
response:
After a while, the bunny felt healthy again and decided to go back outside. It hopped around and played in the sun. But then, a big, mean dog came along and chased the bunny. The bunny tried to run away, but it couldn't go fast enough. The dog caught the bunny and hurt it.
The bunny was no longer healthy and couldn't hop around anymore. It was very sad and had to stay in its burrow all the time. The bunny wished it had never gone back outside. The end.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy accidentally hits his little sister's favorite object with a stick while playing, and his mom teaches him to be more careful with other people's things.
With: happy ending
response:
Suddenly, Timmy accidentally hit his little sister's favorite object with the stick. She started to scream and cry, and Timmy felt very bad. He knew he had done something wrong.
Later that day, Timmy's mom talked to him about being careful with other people's things. She explained that when we break or damage someone else's object, it can make them very upset. Timmy promised to always be more careful in the future. From that day on, Timmy learned to treat other people's objects with care and respect.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily hurts her knee while playing outside and her mom puts a band-aid on it. Later, when her brother wants to play with her toys, she learns the importance of sharing and being kind to others.
With: happy ending
response:
Later that day, Lily's little brother wanted to play with her toys, but she didn't want to share. Her brother started to cry and asked her nicely if he could play with them, but Lily said no. Her mom heard them arguing and asked what was wrong. Lily's brother told their mom that Lily wouldn't share her toys. 
Lily's mom explained to her that it's important to share and be kind to others. Lily realized that she was being mean and apologized to her brother. From that day on, Lily learned to share and be kind to others, even if it meant giving up something she loved.
Summary: Lily hurts her knee while playing outside and her mom puts a band-aid on it. Later, when her brother wants to play with her toys, she learns the importance of sharing and being kind to others.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily's green hair got covered in melted ice cream, causing her to be upset and have to cut it off. She learned to be more careful with her ice cream in the future.
With: sad ending
response:
Lily didn't want to waste the ice cream, so she tried to eat it faster. But it melted too fast and dripped all over her green hair. She got very upset and started to cry. Her mommy tried to help her clean up, but the melted ice cream made a big mess.
Lily was so sad that she didn't want to play anymore. She went to bed early, still upset about her green hair covered in melted ice cream. The next day, she woke up and her hair was a big, sticky mess. She had to cut it all off and was very sad. From then on, she learned to be more careful with her ice cream and not let it melt all over her hair.
Summary: Lily's green hair got covered in melted ice cream, causing her to be upset and have to cut it off. She learned to be more careful with her ice cream in the future.

instruction:
Write a story about: Sarah explores the outdoors and appreciates the small creatures she encounters, including an ant, bee, and bird. She shares her adventure with her mom.
With: happy ending
response:
Once there was a little girl named Sarah and she liked to explore the outdoors. She was always excited to see what the world had to offer!
One day, she went out exploring and saw a small ant. She watched it crawl around and she couldn't help but admire its humble activity. She nodded in appreciation and kept learning.
She continued exploring and found a bee. It was buzzing around and she knew it was important for nature. She also nodded in appreciation and kept exploring.
She looked around some more and found a tiny bird in a tree. She knew it was so special. She smiled and nodded in appreciation.
When she got home, she told her mom all about her adventure. Her mom smiled, proud of her daughter's inquisitive nature, and they nodded in agreement.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy shrinks after a potion is accidentally dropped in his pool, but has fun exploring the miniature world before his mom finds a way to make him big again.
With: happy ending
response:
But then, something magical happened. Timmy's mom accidentally dropped a potion in the pool. The potion made Timmy shrink! He was now as small as a bug. 
Timmy's mom was very polite and apologized for what happened. She promised to find a way to make him big again. In the meantime, Timmy had a lot of fun swimming in the pool, even though he was tiny. He saw all sorts of cool things he never noticed before, like tiny bugs and plants. 
Eventually, Timmy's mom found a way to make him big again. Timmy was so happy to be back to his normal size, but he would always remember the fun he had in the pool when he was small.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily and Ben have fun swinging together in the park and enjoy being best friends.

The cat saw what happened and was very sad. The cat tried to help the fish, but it was too late. The fish was not happy anymore, and the cat lost its friend.
Summary: A cat and fish were friends until the cat accidentally put ink in the fish's home, causing the fish to become unhappy and the friendship to end.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily breaks the law and her mommy suggests they write a letter to the police to apologize. The police forgives her and they learn the importance of following the law and apologizing when wrong.
With: happy ending
response:
Then, her mommy had an idea. She said, "Let's send a letter to the police and say sorry." Lily thought that was a good idea and helped her mommy write the letter. They put it in an envelope and sent it to the police station. 
A few days later, they got a letter back from the police. It said, "Thank you for saying sorry. We forgive you." Lily felt happy and her mommy was no longer angry. They learned that it's important to follow the law and say sorry when we do something wrong.

instruction:
Write a story about: Sarah attends a sign language meeting with her family and learns how to sign with the help of a friendly lady.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time there was a little girl called Sarah. Sarah wanted to go to a meeting with her family. She wondered what the meeting would be like.
When they arrived, Sarah was surprised. Everyone was making weird noises. She asked her mum, "What is this meeting?"
Mum replied, "This is a sign language meeting." Sarah wondered why she was brought here.
Sarah watched as everybody spoke in a different language. She couldn't understand any of them. Sarah started to feel very scared.
Suddenly, a friendly lady came over and offered to teach Sarah how to sign. Sarah was very happy. She learned quickly and soon was able to communicate with people in the meeting. Sarah was no longer scared, she was excited about her new skill.
Summary: Sarah attends a sign language meeting with her family and learns how to sign with the help of a friendly lady.

instruction:
Write a story about: Three wild animal friends find a box of jewelry and start wearing it, but their pride and quarrels over the jewelry teach them the importance of kindness and understanding in friendship.
With: happy ending
response:
Once there was three wild animals living in a forest. One animal was a fox, one was a deer and one was a wolf. They were all friends, even though they were different. 
One day, the fox found a box of jewelry. It was a treasure! The fox ran to find his friends. He showed them the jewelry and said 'We can use these to make us look pretty!' The deer and the wolf were excited and agreed.
So, the three animals started wearing the jewelry. Everywhere they went, people noticed them and thought they must look special. But, soon the animals became too proud of themselves and started bragging and quarrel. 
The animals soon learned that it's important to be kind and understand to be friends. They gave the jewelry away and continued to be best friends without it.

instruction:
Write a story about: A once happy city becomes sad after something is added to it, and despite the people's efforts to find out what happened and make it happy again, they are unsuccessful and the city remains sad forever.
With: sad ending
response:
Once there was a great city. It was full of happiness and joy.
One day, the city started to become sad. Someone had added something to the city, and it wasn't good.
The people of the city tried to find out what had happened and why the city was so sad. They searched high and low, but couldn't find anything.
The people kept trying, but nothing they did made the city happy again. No matter how hard they tried, nothing was working.
The people of the city gave up and the city stayed sad forever. The people never found out what had been added to make it so unhappy.
Summary: A once happy city becomes sad after something is added to it, and despite the people's efforts to find out what happened and make it happy again, they are unsuccessful and the city remains sad forever.

instruction:
Write a story about: Amy and her mom make a big pancake together, and Amy learns the importance of sharing.
With: happy ending
response:
As they cooked, Amy's mom said, "Amy, please be careful with the pan. It is hot." Amy listened and was very careful. When the pancake was done, they put it on a plate. But the pancake was too big for one person. So, Amy's mom took a knife and split the pancake into two pieces. One for Amy and one for her mom.
Amy's mom said, "Look, the pancake is flexible. It can bend and share." Amy smiled and learned that sharing is caring. They both ate the pancake and were very happy.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy sails his toy boat in a park pond but it gets blown away by the wind. His mom helps him find it and they retrieve it from some bushes.
With: happy ending
response:
"Mom, can I sail my boat in the pond?" Timmy asked.
"Yes, you can. But be careful not to fall in," his mom replied.
Timmy put his boat in the water and it sailed away. He laughed and said, "This is silly fun!" 
Suddenly, a gust of wind blew and the boat sailed far away. Timmy was sad. 
"Don't worry, Timmy. We'll get your boat back," his mom said. 
They searched and searched until they found the boat stuck in some bushes. Timmy was happy again and said, "Thank you, Mom! That was a fun Sunday sail!"

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy discovers a pond while exploring the forest and meets a frog who reminds him to always let someone know where he is going.
With: happy ending
response:
As he was watching the fish, he heard a little voice say, "What are you doing here?" It was a frog who lived in the pond. Timmy replied, "I'm just looking at all the fish. This pond is so cool!" The frog replied, "Yes, it is. But you shouldn't be here all by yourself. It's not safe."
Timmy felt guilty for not telling his mom where he was going. He realized that it's important to always let someone know where you are. From that day on, Timmy always made sure to tell his mom where he was going before he went on any adventures.

instruction:
Write a story about: A rich man who never wanted to pay for anything had to go to the store to buy more stuff but refused to pay for it, leading to a lesson learned.
With: happy ending
response:
Once there was a rich man. He had lots of stuff. He never wanted to pay for anything.
But one day, something went wrong. He ran out of stuff and had to go to the store to buy more. The storekeeper asked for money, but the rich man didn't want to pay. He wanted to get the stuff for free.
The storekeeper was very mad. He told the rich man that if he didn't pay, he couldn't have the stuff. The rich man got angry and tried to take the stuff without paying.
But the storekeeper stopped him and said, "You have to pay for the stuff if you want it!"
So the rich man had to pay for the stuff. He was very sad, but he learned his lesson. From then on, he promised himself he would always pay for his stuff.

instruction:
Write a story about: Tom the cat and Jerry the mouse attend a party where they discover the cake is made of paper, but still have fun together.
With: happy ending
response:
At the party, Tom saw a big cake. He stared at it. He wanted to eat it all. A little mouse named Jerry saw Tom staring at the cake. Jerry said, "Hi Tom, do you want to share the cake?" Tom said, "Yes, let's share it."
But when they went to cut the cake, something unexpected happened. The cake was not real! It was made of paper. Tom and Jerry laughed. They had fun at the party even without the cake.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily spends all her money on a mineral at the store, but it breaks when she gets home, making her sad and teaching her a lesson about spending money wisely.
With: sad ending
response:
At the store, Lily saw a pretty rock that sparkled in the sunlight. Her mommy told her it was a mineral and Lily wanted it so badly. She spent all her money on the mineral and ran home to show her daddy.
But when Lily got home, she accidentally dropped the mineral and it broke into a million pieces. Lily was so sad and cried all night. She learned that sometimes, spending all your money on one thing can lead to a bad ending.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily and Timmy make wishes on a shooting star and become friends.
With: happy ending
response:
Lily wanted to make a wish, so she closed her eyes and made a wish. Suddenly, she heard a voice behind her. It was a boy named Timmy. He was ignorant about shooting stars and asked Lily what she was doing. Lily explained that she was making a wish.
Timmy was interested and asked if he could make a wish too. Lily said yes and they both closed their eyes and made a wish. After that, they became friends and played together in the park. From that day on, Lily and Timmy always followed each other around and looked for shooting stars together.

instruction:
Write a story about: A queen gets lost while walking in the woods but is helped by a friendly dog and is able to find her way back home.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time, there was a queen. Everybody loved her because she was so kind and made them feel comfortable. She went for long walks in the woods and enjoyed visiting the animals.
One day the queen went for a long walk, but she missed her way back home. She tried and tried to find her way but she couldn't. Suddenly, a friendly dog came up to her and helped her find her way back.
The queen was so happy and thanked the dog. After that, she never missed her way again and continued going for lovely walks in the woods with her animal friends.
Summary: A queen gets lost while walking in the woods but is helped by a friendly dog and is able to find her way back home.

instruction:
Write a story about: Harley and her mom go to the park, where Harley wants to play in the pond but her mom suggests playing on the swing set instead after checking it for safety.
With: happy ending
response:
Harley and her mom were walking in the park. Harley looked around and noticed that there was a pond filled with wet water. She looked at her mom and said “Mommy, can I play in the wet?”.
Her mom smiled and said “No, sweetie. You need to stay on the dry grass”.
Harley started to feel a bit disappointed, but then she noticed a swing set. She grabbed her mom’s hand and asked “Mommy, can I play on the swing set?”
Her mom looked at the swing set and said “Yes, sweetheart. But first, let's discuss to make sure it’s fit for you.”
Harley was excited! She waited patiently as her mom tested the swing set for safety. After discussing the swing set, her mom gave her the go ahead to play.
Harley jumped on the swing set and started playing, feeling fit, happy and dry.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy learns the importance of cleaning up after himself and taking care of his toys, and that if something gets broken, it can be fixed.
With: happy ending
response:
Timmy didn't want that to happen, so he started to clean up. He picked up all his toys and put them away in his chest. When he was done, he felt proud of himself for being a good helper. But then, he accidentally snapped one of his toys in half. Timmy felt sad and started to cry.
His mom came over and said, "It's okay, Timmy. We can fix it together." They worked together to fix the broken toy and it was good as new. Timmy learned that it's important to clean up after yourself and to take care of your things. And if something does break, it's okay because you can always fix it.
Summary: Timmy learns the importance of cleaning up after himself and taking care of his toys, and that if something gets broken, it can be fixed.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily goes to the park, stubs her toe, but bravely slides down a big slide and sees a beautiful butterfly at the bottom.
With: happy ending
response:
As she climbed up the ladder, she accidentally stubbed her toe on a rock. It hurt a lot, but she didn't cry. She reached the top of the slide and looked down. It was very high! But she was brave and decided to slide down.
As she slid down, she saw something colorful at the bottom. It was a beautiful butterfly! The butterfly flew away, but Lily was happy she got to see it. She knew that sometimes, when you enter a new place or try something new, you might find something special.
Summary: Lily goes to the park, stubs her toe, but bravely slides down a big slide and sees a beautiful butterfly at the bottom.

instruction:

Her mom rushed her to the hospital, but it was too late. Lily had eaten a bad apple and became very sick. The end.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily discovers avocados and learns a lesson about taking care of her belongings and not taking things that don't belong to her.

response:

Summary: Lily discovers avocados and learns a lesson about taking care of her belongings and not taking things that don't belong to her.

instruction:
Write a story about: A beautiful and delicious rose brings happiness to people who pick and eat it. The moral of the story is that happiness can come from simple things.

response:
Once upon a time there was a beautiful rose. The rose glowed in the sunshine and sparkled in the rain. Everywhere the rose went, people smiled and asked what it was.
The rose said, "I am a delicious rose!" Everyone was so excited to hear the answer. Everyone wanted some of the delicious rose.
So the people picked the rose and brought it home. They all ate the rose and it was the most delicious thing they ever tasted. Everyone was so happy and they all glowed with joy!
The moral of the story is that happiness can come from the simplest of things!
Summary: A beautiful and delicious rose brings happiness to people who pick and eat it. The moral of the story is that happiness can come from simple things.

instruction:
Write a story about: A little girl plays with a red thread and gets it stuck, but her mom helps her free it and they play with it together.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time there was a red thread. It was long and stretchy. One day, a little girl wanted to play with it. She grabbed the red thread and started slapping it against the wall. Bang! Bang! The thread hit the wall. It made such a fun noise!
The little girl had so much fun that she kept playing with the red thread. She kept slapping it against the wall and giggling. Suddenly, the thread got stuck on something. The little girl tried to pull it away, but it wouldn't budge. She started to yell and cry.
Luckily, her mom was there to help her. She guided the little girl's hands carefully as they pulled the thread away. The red thread was finally free! The little girl smiled and hugged her mom. They played with the red thread together for the rest of the day.

instruction:
Write a story about: A little bird scatters seeds for her friends in a forest, but gets lost in a thick mist and falls to the ground, leaving her friends sad without her.
With: happy ending
response:
One day, a thick mist covered the forest. The little bird could not see her friends or the ground. She was scared, but she still wanted to scatter seeds for her friends.
The little bird tried to fly low, but she could not see well in the mist. She hit a tree and fell to the ground. Her friends looked for her, but they could not find her in the mist. The little bird did not get up, and her friends were sad without her.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily and Max have a coloring competition, and Lily wins by polishing her paper with a crayon.
With: happy ending
response:
Max said, "Wow, Lily! Your drawing is so pretty! You are very good at coloring."
Lily smiled and said, "Thank you, Max. I like to color. Do you want to color with me?"
Max said, "Sure, but I want to win. Let's have a competition. We will both color the same picture and see who does it better."
Lily agreed and they both started to color. After a while, Max said, "I think I am done. Let's see who wins."
Lily looked at Max's paper and said, "Your coloring is good, but my paper is better. I polished it with my crayon."
Max looked at Lily's paper and said, "You're right. Your paper is better. You win, Lily!"
Lily smiled and said, "Thank you, Max. That was a fun competition."
Summary: Lily and Max have a coloring competition, and Lily wins by polishing her paper with a crayon.

instruction:

response: Once upon a time, there was an adorable bunny. Every day the bunny liked to watch different animals. He loved to observe their movements and listen to their language. One day, the bunny was watching a big elephant. The elephant trumpeted a warning to the bunny. But the bunny did not see it or hear it. The elephant got scared and trumpeted again. The bunny did not understand the language. So he just watched the elephant. Suddenly, the elephant stepped on the bunny's foot and crushed it. The bunny felt pain and could not hop anymore. He had a bad ending.

instruction:

response:
Once there was a paw. It was slow and it knew it. Every day it tried to move quicker, but was never fast enough.
The paw kept trying and one day it did it. It ran faster than it had ever done before. Everyone saw, and clapped and cheered. The paw felt so happy.
The paw kept getting faster. It raced and ran, and it was the fastest paw ever. It could go so quickly that no one else could keep up.
Every night the paw would go to sleep, happy and content, for it now knew it was the fastest that there was. It felt so satisfied that it never wanted to run slow ever again.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily goes to the park with her parents, has fun on the big slide, but forgets her spoon. She learns the importance of keeping track of her things.

response:
After playing for a while, Lily's parents said it was time to go home. They got in their car and drove away. But Lily realized she left her spoon at the park! She begged her parents to go back, but they said it was too distant and they couldn't go back.
Lily felt sad and cried all the way home. She learned that it's important to keep track of your things so you don't lose them. The moral of the story is to always double-check before you leave a place and make sure you have everything you brought with you.

instruction:
Write a story about: A messy sheep on a farm loves to play in the mud and gets accepted by the farmer and other animals for being different.
With: happy ending
response:
One day, the farmer asked all the animals to come and listen to him. He had a question, and he wanted an answer from each animal. The animals all lined up and got ready to answer the farmer. The messy sheep was last because it was still playing in the mud.
The farmer asked, "What do you like to do on the farm?" Each animal gave their answer. The cow liked to eat grass, the pig liked to roll in the mud, and the chicken liked to lay eggs. When it was the messy sheep's turn, it said, "I like to be messy and play in the mud!" The farmer laughed and said, "You are a very special sheep. We love you just the way you are." The messy sheep was very happy and continued to play in the mud every day.

instruction:

When it was time to go home, Lily realized she had lost her special penny. She was sad, but her mommy said, "Don't worry, Lily. Maybe someone else will find it and think it's interesting too." Lily felt better knowing that her penny might make someone else happy.

instruction:

Mittens came across a mean old witch who wanted to shrink her down to the size of a mouse. Mittens tried to run away but she was too slow. The witch cast a spell and Mittens started to shrink. She became so small that she could fit in the palm of the witch's hand.
The witch cackled with glee as she put Mittens in a jar and took her back to her cottage. Mittens was trapped and couldn't escape. She missed her owner and her warm cozy bed. Mittens cried herself to sleep every night. Sadly, she never saw her owner again and lived the rest of her life in the witch's jar.
Summary: Mittens, a kitten, gets lost in the forest and is captured by a witch who shrinks her down and keeps her in a jar.

instruction:

response:
Before the race, Tom and his friend, Sam, talked. "I will win the race!" said Tom. Sam smiled and said, "We will see."
The race began, and all the kids ran fast. Tom felt sure he would win. But then, something unexpected happened. His long tail got stuck in a tree. Tom tried to get free, but he couldn't.
Sam saw Tom and stopped to help. But while they were busy, all the other kids ran past them. In the end, Tom and Sam lost the race. They were sad but learned that sometimes, it's better to help a friend than to win.

instruction:

response:

Then, Ella had an idea. She used her long trunk to pull on a tree branch. The tree shook and leaves fell down. Ella was happy and shared the leaves with her friends. They all ate and played together. The nice elephant and her friends were happy again.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily spills juice on her new couch and breaks her bed while playing with her brother, resulting in them having to sleep on the floor.

response:

Later that day, Lily's little brother came to play with her. They were having fun jumping on the bed when suddenly the bed broke! They fell off and hurt themselves. Lily's mom came in and saw the broken bed and was very angry. She scolded them and sent them to bed early.
Lily learned her lesson and promised to be more careful with the furniture in the house. But unfortunately, the bad ending was that Lily and her brother had to sleep on the floor because their bed was broken.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily disobeys her mother's warning and gets hurt, learning that it's important to listen to her mother's advice.

Lily started to cry because her knee hurt. Her mommy came to help her, but they had to go to the hospital. Lily got a shot and a bandage on her knee. She learned that sometimes it's better to listen to her mommy and not touch or turn things that might be dangerous.
Summary: Lily disobeys her mother's warning and gets hurt, learning that it's important to listen to her mother's advice.

instruction:
Write a story about: A little girl named Lily picks a pretty flower and shows it to her mom, who teaches her about measuring.
With: happy ending
response:
Her mom said, "That's a pretty flower, Lily. What do you think of it?" 
Lily said, "I like it. It's my favorite." 
Her mom smiled and asked, "Can you measure how tall it is?" 
Lily shook her head and said, "No, I don't know how to measure things yet." 
Her mom explained, "Measuring is when we find out how big or tall something is. It's like when we measure how much milk we need for cereal." 
Lily nodded and said, "Oh, I understand now. But I still think my flower is the prettiest."
Summary: A little girl named Lily picks a pretty flower and shows it to her mom, who teaches her about measuring.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily's favorite jacket gets dirty while playing outside, but she cleans it in the laundry room and is happy to wear it again.
With: happy ending
response:
While she was playing, she accidentally fell into a muddy puddle and her jacket got very dirty. When she came back inside, her mom saw her dirty jacket and said, "Oh no, Lily! Your jacket is very dirty. You need to clean it before you wear it again."
Lily replied, "Okay, Mommy. I will clean it." She took her jacket and went to the laundry room. She put it in the washing machine and added some soap. After the washing machine finished, she took her jacket out and hung it up to dry. 
When her jacket was clean and dry, Lily put it on and said, "Look, Mommy! My jacket is clean again!" Her mom smiled and said, "Good job, Lily. Now you can wear your warm jacket again." Lily was happy to have her clean and warm jacket back.
Summary: Lily's favorite jacket gets dirty while playing outside, but she cleans it in the laundry room and is happy to wear it again.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily helps a lost duckling find its mother in the park and learns the importance of helping others.
With: happy ending
response:
Lily decided to go for a walk in the park. While she was walking, she saw a little duckling. The duckling looked sad and miserable. Lily asked the duckling what was wrong. The duckling said, "I lost my mommy and I don't know where to go." 
Lily felt sad for the duckling and decided to help. She said, "Don't worry, little duckling! I will follow you and help you find your mommy." So, Lily followed the duckling through the park. After a while, they found the mommy duck and the duckling was happy again. 
The moral of the story is that it's important to help others, even if it means doing something that you don't like, like taking a pill. And sometimes, helping others can make you feel happy too.

instruction:
Write a story about: Charlotte learns how to use a hose to water the garden and is excited to show her mom.
With: happy ending
response:
Once there was a young girl named Charlotte. Charlotte was very excited to learn something new. She was going to learn about hoses! Her Mom showed her how to attach the hose to the tap outside the house. Charlotte was so excited she could barely control her body. She jumped around and clapped her hands.
Charlotte watched as her Mom turned on the tap. The water came gushing out of the hose. Charlotte was so happy she screamed with joy. She took the hose and started to play with the water.
Charlotte was learning how to use the hose to water the garden. She found that she could put the water exactly where it was needed. Trainer droplets, gentle stream, and pouring jubilation.
Charlotte was so proud that she had been able to learn how to use the hose. She ran back inside the house to show her Mom. She was so excited, she was hopping with joy. Charlotte's Mom gave her a hug and said that she was very proud.

instruction:
Write a story about: A fragile little owl is too scared to fly, but with the help of his friend the squirrel and a local repairman, he is fixed and able to fly freely.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time there was a little owl. He was very fragile and could easily break. One day the owl wanted to fly, but he was too scared that he might break.
So, his friend the squirrel decided to help. He went to the local repair shop and asked the man to repair the owl. The man had special glue that he could use to fix the owl.
The squirrel watched as the man slowly repaired the owl. He used the glue carefully and slowly. Once the man was done, the owl thanked him for his help.
The owl was now strong and ready to fly. He flew around the forest, enjoying the freedom that he now had.
The end.

instruction:
Write a story about: A brave fireman in a small town loads his shiny red fire truck with all the necessary equipment to be prepared for a storm. When a house catches fire during the storm, he rushes to the scene and uses his equipment to put out the fire and save the people inside.
With: happy ending
response:
One day, the fireman heard that a big storm was coming. He wanted to make sure he was ready to help if there was a fire. So, he went to the fire truck and started to load it with all the things he would need. He put in water, a long hose, and a ladder. He also made sure his red hat and coat were in the truck.
The next day, the storm came. It was loud and had lots of rain and wind. Suddenly, the fireman got a call. A house was on fire! He put on his red hat and coat and drove the fire truck as fast as he could. When he got there, he used the hose and water he had loaded in the truck to put out the fire. The people in the house were safe, and they were very happy. The fireman was a hero!

instruction:
Write a story about: A mother teaches her daughter how to do her own makeup so she can be independent.

response:
Once upon a time there was a mother, who supported her daughter so much. She always helped her daughter get dressed in the morning and put on her makeup. One morning, the mother became very serious. She told her daughter, "You need to learn how to do your own makeup. I won't always be here to help you do it." 
The daughter was surprised by this news. She asked the mother, "How will I know how to do my own makeup?"
The mother replied, "I'll help you practice and I can show you how it's done. But you will need to pay close attention and be serious when we are practicing." 
The daughter promised to be serious, and that day the mother showed her daughter how to properly apply makeup. Although the daughter made mistakes, the mother was always patient and supportive. From then on, the daughter did her own makeup every morning.
Summary: A mother teaches her daughter how to do her own makeup so she can be independent.

instruction:
Write a story about: A little girl named Lily loses her pet rat, Ratty, after letting her friend Timmy play with him and accidentally hurting him. She learns to be more careful and not take chances.
With: sad ending
response:
Later that day, Lily and Timmy played with Ratty together. Ratty seemed happy to have two friends to play with. But then, suddenly, Timmy accidentally hurt Ratty.
